content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Collection Pipelines** as part of **Functional Programming and Idiomatic Kotlin**. Select a collection by the invariants you need—ordering, uniqueness, key lookup, or indexed access—and check the cost of transformations. Use the subtopics—Chaining filter , map , and flatMap, Ordering Transformations, Avoiding Unnecessary Intermediate Collections—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
